item.title: Version 2.0.14
item.description:
Quick actions on Home cards, export and print for Notes, and Settings that feel more like macOS.

  • Home — add a reminder, task or event right from its card, AirDrop everything on the shelf, add world clock cities and start a new Obsidian note
  • Notes — export a note as a PDF, Word document, rich text or plain text, or print it with ⌘P
  • Now Playing and Face Unlock — the player fills the larger panel sizes, and Face Unlock lets you pick its camera and gets ready faster after your Mac wakes
  • Minor fixes and refinements — native segmented controls in Settings, Empty Trash asks inside the panel, an untouched reply field closes on its own, smoother sliders on Intel Macs and weather times that follow daylight saving

All release notes

item.title: Version 2.0.13
item.description:
A smarter command palette, an Apple-style player, a much fuller shelf and new ways to capture your screen.

  • Command palette — open apps, System Settings panes and system commands, convert times between cities and work out tips, with inline completion and ⌘K actions
  • Now Playing — a compact Apple-style player, Up Next you can play from, queue, output and lyrics drawers, AirPlay speakers, a Control Center–style app mixer and Kaset support
  • Shelf and clipboard — drop wells in the notch, Rename and New Folder with Selection, expand any archive, compress PDFs and videos, AirDrop and LocalSend arrivals, watched folders and a clipboard strip above the Dock
  • Capture and more — Element Capture, Capture Text, auto-zoom recordings, dictation at the cursor, a window switcher, Home in the menu bar with Storage, Obsidian, Things and Sales cards, gift a license, and many refinements

All release notes

item.title: Version 2.0.12
item.description:
Qobuz in Now Playing, gentler battery use with the lid closed, and colors for your pet.

  • Now Playing — Qobuz shows its track, artwork and controls in the notch
  • Caffeine — a reminder after hours on, and far less battery used while it keeps a closed Mac awake
  • Desktop pet — pick a color for character pets, like a snow-white or violet fox
  • Minor fixes and refinements — Magic Keyboard brightness keys, a steadier panel, trial end, the timer dial, a timer-done island from your iPhone, see-through Weather widgets, and a clearer note on Apple’s Dynamic Island

All release notes

item.title: Version 2.0.11
item.description:
Notchy makes room for Apple's Dynamic Island, updates arrive smaller and install on their own, and you can share your notch.

  • OLED MacBook Pro — Notchy takes the rounded shape of Apple's Dynamic Island, with its tabs in a dock below the panel, and works beside it instead of covering it
  • Updates — smaller downloads, and a waiting update installs when you lock your Mac
  • Face Unlock — keeps recognizing you as the light or your look changes, and stays on after updates
  • Share Notchy — post a picture of your notch on X or Reddit, from About
  • Minor fixes and refinements — calls on macOS 27.2, exports to SD cards, a shorter clipboard history, timer and stopwatch icons, Files shelf and Shortcuts progress

All release notes

item.title: Version 2.0.10
item.description:
Richer battery alerts, a smarter message banner, and Shortcuts progress.

  • Battery alerts — Low Battery and Fully Charged show the level, how long is left and what to do
  • Message banners — click to open the conversation, with Reply beside it
  • Shortcuts progress — Show Progress in Notchy puts a live progress ring in the notch for any shortcut or script
  • Minor fixes and refinements — installing a downloaded update, Voice Memos, timers, Now Playing, Bluetooth audio and lock screen
